messages:
Juno Kim: hey everyone! i’m Juno — starting today on infra/serving. super excited to be here :wave:. quick q: where’s the best coffee in the office and how do i get a badge? :coffee:
Arun Patel: welcome Juno!! badge process is front desk — show ID and they hand out a temp badge the first day. permanent badge -> file a facilities ticket. coffee = espresso machine by the kitchen + beans in the metal locker. :thumbsup:
Casey Lopez: welcome!! also FYI the third-floor kettle is cursed, use the one by design. lunch crew meets at 12:30 in the break area most days. i’ll DM you the badge request form link.
Riley: :tada: welcome Juno! for the permanent badge, email facilities@redwood.com and mention the office location. usual turnaround ~2 business days. If you need a door override today let me know and I’ll route it.
welcome-bot: Welcome Juno Kim to #new-hires! :party-popper: Checklist created: laptop provisioning, security training, facilities badge. See onboarding docs: https://intranet.redwood/onboarding
Juno Kim: amazing, thanks all!! quick follow-up — is there a plant watering rota or anything silly like that? happy to sign up. also any recs for lunch nearby?
Arun Patel: plant rota is the whiteboard in the kitchen, people scribble their initials. food recs: taco truck behind the building on Thursdays, good sandwich place two blocks east.
Casey Lopez: we also have a #weekend-hikes channel if you’re into that. sunday group leaves 9am. ping me and I’ll add you.
Juno Kim: love that — count me in for tacos and hikes. thanks for the warm welcome everyone :heart:
